representative_profiles.scope: representative synthetic profiles; not full catalog, owner pipeline, or three-compiler certification

limitations: Profile matrix is representative synthetic output; it is not a complete catalog or owner-pipeline certification.
Shipped-template coverage exercised all 61 templates with LuaLaTeX only; it does not establish XeLaTeX or pdfLaTeX coverage.
The bridge contract run covered compilation convergence, bounded wait, cancellation, and absolute deadline behavior; it was not a full application end-to-end test.
This evidence does not certify the three requested security boundary probes. A separate approval-gated harness was prepared and not run.
Historical failed attempts are retained privately; the successful final artifacts above do not erase them.

history.note: Earlier matrix found CJK font and Hindi/Marathi language-command issues; corrected source was then retested in the passing 14684 matrix.
Recorder confinement check used the operator-side temp path; corrected to the bridge-reported VM workspace before attempt 2. This was a harness defect, not a passing certification.

publish_notes.sanitization: No credentials, raw logs, extracted document text, local artifact paths, customer data, or provider data are included. Individual source/PDF hashes and bounded quality/cleanup checks are retained.
